items.name: Weeknight Butter Chicken
items.desc: Rich, mild tomato and cream curry that comes together in one pan. A reliable crowd-pleaser.
ingredients: Coriander and steamed rice, to serve
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yoghurt and half the garam masala for 20 minutes (or overnight).
Melt the butter in a large pan over medium heat and soften the onion, garlic and ginger.
Stir in the remaining spices and cook for a minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Add the chicken and cook through, about 10 minutes.
Stir through the cream, season, and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Serve over rice, scattered with coriander.

items.name: Garlic Butter Pasta
items.desc: A 20-minute pantry dinner — garlic, butter, lemon and parmesan.
steps: Cook the pasta in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve a cup of pasta water before draining.
Melt the butter over low heat and gently cook the garlic and chilli until fragrant but not browned.
Add the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water and toss to coat.
Off the heat, stir through the lemon, parsley and parmesan, loosening with more pasta water as needed.
